an4.260:1.1: catuhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.260:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balasampanno ca, javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.260:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.260:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hotī, [pāhuṇeyyo - dakkhiṇeyyo - añjalikaraṇīyo] …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an4.260:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balasampanno ca javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.260:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an4.260:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an4.260:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati. thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an4.260:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an4.260:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.260:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an4.260:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti.
an4.260:7.1: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti, [pāhuṇeyyo - dakkhiṇeyyo - añjalikaraṇīyo] …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
